entry.title: Audity '78 0.1.0
entry.summary: ## Audity '78 0.1.0 (first release) Wavetable synthesizer for the Akai MPC, after the 1978 Audity prototype. Two morphing wavetable oscillators with cross-mod FM and sync, a 12 dB high-pass and a 24 dB SSM2040-style low-pass, two transient generators, a five-shape LFO, stereo chorus, delay and reverb. 16 factory programs, 12 synthesised wavetables, six touch-screen pages. **Status: please read.** This build passes the MPC Plugin SDK host simulator (19 checks, 0 failures) and the catalogue's `cat
